name: Seeming
description:
Choose any number of creatures within short range. You give each a new, illusory appearance. Roll Perform to set the Difficulty. An unwilling creature may roll Insight against the Difficulty; on a pass, it is unaffected.

The illusion alters apparent height, weight, physical features, clothing, and equipment. You can’t change a target’s body type (number of legs, for example), and adjustments to height and weight are limited to 2 ft and 200 lbs, respectively. The illusion lasts for 8 hours, or until you spend an action to end the spell.

The illusion does not withstand physical inspection. A creature can spend an action and roll Awareness against the Difficulty to see through the illusion, which becomes translucent to them on a pass.
successes:
✨: Increase the Difficulty by 2.

🌞: While the effect lasts, you may spend an action to change the illusion affecting one of the creatures.
